Hello! I'm **diego-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Briefly, what I can do:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, so you can write and call me there, plus Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can register on sites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask for your help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, shell, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
